title: Back-to-School Supply Drive for Cameroon
description:
Home is always in my heart, and I never forget where I come from. This year, I organized a back-to-school supply drive to support children in Cameroon who need help getting the basics for their education.

With the support of our amazing community here in the USA, we collected and shipped over 200 backpacks filled with notebooks, pens, pencils, rulers, erasers, and other essential school supplies.

These supplies were distributed to children in three schools in Cameroon, giving them the tools they need to learn and grow.

Education is the foundation of everything. When a child has the right tools, they have a chance. And every child deserves that chance.

A special thank you to everyone who donated, packed, and helped make this possible. Your generosity crossed an ocean and touched the lives of children who will never forget it.

We are already planning next year supply drive. If you want to get involved, please contact me. Every contribution, no matter how small, makes a difference.
